title: **Date: 28 Bahman 1404 (17 February 2026)**
text:
**Date: 28 Bahman 1404 (17 February 2026)**"

"**Excerpt from the remarks of the martyred leader Ayatollah Seyed Ali Khamenei:**"

"💠 **No Geographic Limits — A Bridle to Restrain America**"

"By order of the Supreme Leader of the Revolution, the self-imposed limit on missile range has been lifted; after breaking agreements and shedding blood, the enemies must expect an unbounded response.
